plain_text:
Sydney Greenstreet appears in 28 recordings across 4 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1945 to 1951. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Sydney Greenstreet most often in The New Adventures of Nero Wolfe, Academy Award Theater, Command Performance, and The Fred Allen Show.

Characters credited here include Nero Wolfe.
